item.title: The unseen work of ECEC leaders in a crisis, and why shared leadership matters
item.description: When floods, bushfires or other crises disrupt an early childhood education and care (ECEC) service, someone has to make decisions about staffing, safety, communication and continuity of care. An Australian study suggests that leaders also carry a less visible responsibility: absorbing uncertainty and helping their teams and families manage it.
